Teams

About this page

A team is a name that says who owns an app. It shows on the Deployments list and map, filters them, and is on each app's logs and traces as swhurl.team. It does not grant or restrict anyone's access.

No GitHub token is configured, so the team registry on main cannot be read. The teams below are the ones apps name now; descriptions and teams without apps are missing, and no app can be called unregistered.

Channel
An ntfy topic URL. The topic is the credential: anyone who knows it can read and post, so use a long random one.
